title: General Roya makes him a warrant officer, then chief warrant officer

tellings.quote: he said uh uh I'm going to make you a warrant officer

plain: Between 1977 and 1979, at Army headquarters in the United States, a general he calls Roya told him, "I'm going to make you a warrant officer," a rank between enlisted soldiers and commissioned officers, and later made him a chief warrant officer. The former Army man Joe McMoneagle tells this about his own career, as part of how he came to be placed in the special work he did for the Army.
